title: BÀI TẬP THÌ QUÁ KHỨ HOÀN THÀNH

exercise_groups.group_title: 1. Dạng Khẳng Định (+) S + had + V3/ed (10 Câu)
exercise_groups.instruction: Chia động từ trong ngoặc ở thì Quá khứ hoàn thành:

questions.prompt: The guest (leave) [blank] the party before the cake was served.
answers: had left
questions.explanation: V3 của 'leave' là 'left' ➔ had left.

questions.prompt: She (already read) [blank] the book before the teacher assigned it in class.
answers: had already read
questions.explanation: Already đứng giữa had và V3; V3 của 'read' viết là 'read' ➔ had already read.

questions.prompt: The athlete (train) [blank] for months before the championship started.
answers: had trained
questions.explanation: Động từ có quy tắc thêm -ed ➔ had trained.

questions.prompt: They (finish) [blank] their homework before their friends arrived to play.
answers: had finished
questions.explanation: Finish có quy tắc ➔ had finished.

questions.prompt: He (visit) [blank] that museum before it was renovated.
answers: had visited
questions.explanation: Visit có quy tắc ➔ had visited.

questions.prompt: The company (achieve) [blank] significant growth before the merger was announced.
answers: had achieved
questions.explanation: Achieve kết thúc bằng -e chỉ thêm -d ➔ had achieved.

questions.prompt: The child (fall asleep) [blank] before the movie ended.
answers: had fallen asleep
questions.explanation: V3 của 'fall' là 'fallen' ➔ had fallen asleep.

questions.prompt: The students (complete) [blank] their projects before the competition began.
answers: had completed
questions.explanation: Complete kết thúc bằng -e chỉ thêm -d ➔ had completed.

questions.prompt: The manager (discuss) [blank] the plan with the team before presenting it to the board.
answers: had discussed
questions.explanation: Discuss có quy tắc thêm -ed ➔ had discussed.

questions.prompt: The traveler (see) [blank] many famous landmarks before arriving in this city.
answers: had seen
questions.explanation: V3 của 'see' là 'seen' ➔ had seen.

exercise_groups.group_title: 2. Dạng Phủ Định (–) S + had + NOT + V3/ed (10 Câu)
exercise_groups.instruction: Chia động từ trong ngoặc ở thể phủ định của thì Quá khứ hoàn thành:

questions.prompt: The guest (not leave) [blank] the venue before the speech began.
answers: had not left
hadn't left
questions.explanation: Phủ định: had not left / hadn't left.

questions.prompt: She (not complete) [blank] her assignment before the submission deadline passed.
answers: had not completed
hadn't completed
questions.explanation: Phủ định: had not completed / hadn't completed.

questions.prompt: The athlete (not recover) [blank] from his injury before the tournament started.
answers: had not recovered
hadn't recovered
questions.explanation: Phủ định: had not recovered / hadn't recovered.

questions.prompt: They (not prepare) [blank] the decorations before the event coordinator arrived.
answers: had not prepared
hadn't prepared
questions.explanation: Phủ định: had not prepared / hadn't prepared.

questions.prompt: The family (not move) [blank] to their new house before the school year began.
answers: had not moved
hadn't moved
questions.explanation: Phủ định: had not moved / hadn't moved.

questions.prompt: The project (not start) [blank] before the funding was approved.
answers: had not started
hadn't started
questions.explanation: Phủ định: had not started / hadn't started.

questions.prompt: He (not try) [blank] sushi before visiting Japan.
answers: had not tried
hadn't tried
questions.explanation: Phủ định: had not tried / hadn't tried (try đổi y thành i + ed).

questions.prompt: The students (not understand) [blank] the concept before the teacher explained it again.
answers: had not understood
hadn't understood
questions.explanation: V3 của 'understand' là 'understood' ➔ had not understood.

questions.prompt: The pilot (not land) [blank] the plane before the storm intensified.
answers: had not landed
hadn't landed
questions.explanation: Phủ định: had not landed / hadn't landed.

questions.prompt: The cat (not eat) [blank] all the food before the owner returned.
answers: had not eaten
hadn't eaten
questions.explanation: V3 của 'eat' là 'eaten' ➔ had not eaten / hadn't eaten.

exercise_groups.group_title: 3. Dạng Câu Hỏi (?) Had + S + V3/ed? (10 Câu)
exercise_groups.instruction: Điền dạng đúng của động từ trong ngoặc để hoàn thành câu hỏi:

questions.prompt: Had the guest (arrive) [blank] before the host welcomed everyone?
answers: arrived
questions.explanation: Arrive có quy tắc ➔ arrived.

questions.prompt: Had she (already finish) [blank] her report before the manager requested it?
answers: already finished
questions.explanation: Already đứng giữa ➔ already finished.

questions.prompt: Had the athlete (win) [blank] a medal before participating in this competition?
answers: won
questions.explanation: V3 của 'win' là 'won'.

questions.prompt: Had they (prepare) [blank] the meal before the guests arrived?
answers: prepared
questions.explanation: Prepare có quy tắc ➔ prepared.

questions.prompt: Had the company (achieve) [blank] its goals before the fiscal year ended?
answers: achieved
questions.explanation: Achieve có quy tắc ➔ achieved.

questions.prompt: Had the teacher (grade) [blank] all the papers before the meeting began?
answers: graded
questions.explanation: Grade có quy tắc ➔ graded.

questions.prompt: Had the child (fall asleep) [blank] before the parents turned off the lights?
answers: fallen asleep
questions.explanation: V3 của 'fall' là 'fallen' ➔ fallen asleep.

questions.prompt: Had the manager (explain) [blank] the strategy before the team implemented it?
answers: explained
questions.explanation: Explain có quy tắc ➔ explained.

questions.prompt: Had the artist (complete) [blank] the painting before the exhibition?
answers: completed
questions.explanation: Complete có quy tắc ➔ completed.

questions.prompt: Had the family (travel) [blank] to many countries before they settled down?
answers: traveled
travelled
questions.explanation: Traveled hoặc travelled.

exercise_groups.group_title: 4. Viết Lại Câu: Chuyển Sang Câu Hỏi & Câu Phủ Định (+ ➔ ? / -)
exercise_groups.instruction: Chuyển câu khẳng định sang câu hỏi và phủ định tương ứng:

questions.prompt: She had just submitted her report. (Chuyển sang câu hỏi)
answers: she just submitted her report?
she just submitted her report
she submitted her report yet?
she submitted her report yet
questions.explanation: Đảo 'Had' lên trước chủ ngữ: Had she just submitted her report?

questions.prompt: She had just submitted her report. (Chuyển sang phủ định)
answers: had not submitted her report yet.
had not submitted her report yet
hadn't submitted her report yet.
hadn't submitted her report yet
had not just submitted her report.
questions.explanation: Thêm 'not' sau had và đổi sang 'yet' ở cuối: She had not submitted her report yet.

questions.prompt: They had already finished their homework. (Chuyển sang câu hỏi)
answers: they already finished their homework?
they finished their homework yet?
they finished their homework yet
questions.explanation: Đảo 'Had' lên đầu câu: Had they already finished their homework?

questions.prompt: They had already finished their homework. (Chuyển sang phủ định)
answers: had not finished their homework yet.
had not finished their homework yet
hadn't finished their homework yet.
hadn't finished their homework yet
questions.explanation: Phủ định đổi already thành yet: They had not finished their homework yet.

questions.prompt: We had recently moved to a new apartment. (Chuyển sang câu hỏi)
answers: we recently moved to a new apartment?
we recently moved to a new apartment
questions.explanation: Đảo 'Had' lên đầu câu: Had we recently moved to a new apartment?

questions.prompt: We had recently moved to a new apartment. (Chuyển sang phủ định)
answers: had not moved to a new apartment recently.
had not moved to a new apartment recently
hadn't moved to a new apartment recently.
hadn't moved to a new apartment recently
had not recently moved to a new apartment.
questions.explanation: Thêm 'not' sau had: We had not moved to a new apartment recently.

questions.prompt: I had prepared breakfast for everyone. (Chuyển sang câu hỏi)
answers: I prepared breakfast for everyone?
i prepared breakfast for everyone?
questions.explanation: Đảo 'Had' lên trước 'I': Had I prepared breakfast for everyone?

questions.prompt: I had prepared breakfast for everyone. (Chuyển sang phủ định)
answers: had not prepared breakfast for everyone.
had not prepared breakfast for everyone
hadn't prepared breakfast for everyone.
hadn't prepared breakfast for everyone
questions.explanation: Thêm 'not' sau had: I had not prepared breakfast for everyone.

questions.prompt: He had repaired the car before we arrived. (Chuyển sang câu hỏi)
answers: he repaired the car before we arrived?
he repaired the car before we arrived
questions.explanation: Đảo 'Had' lên trước 'he': Had he repaired the car before we arrived?

questions.prompt: He had repaired the car before we arrived. (Chuyển sang phủ định)
answers: had not repaired the car before we arrived.
had not repaired the car before we arrived
hadn't repaired the car before we arrived.
hadn't repaired the car before we arrived
questions.explanation: Thêm 'not' sau had: He had not repaired the car before we arrived.

exercise_groups.group_title: 5. Phân Loại Câu Theo 2 Cách Sử Dụng
exercise_groups.instruction: Chọn nhóm đúng: A (Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ) hoặc B (Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ):

questions.prompt: 1. 'I had finished my assignment by 10 p.m.'
options: A. Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ
B. Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ
questions.explanation: Có mốc thời gian cụ thể 'by 10 p.m.' ➔ Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ.

questions.prompt: 2. 'They had already left before we arrived.'
options: A. Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ
B. Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ
questions.explanation: Rời đi trước khi hành động khác xảy ra ('we arrived') ➔ Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác.

questions.prompt: 3. 'She had packed her suitcase before the taxi came.'
options: A. Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ
B. Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ
questions.explanation: Đóng vali xong trước khi xe taxi tới ('taxi came') ➔ Xảy ra trước hành động khác.

questions.prompt: 4. 'He had never visited a foreign country before that trip.'
options: A. Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ
B. Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ
questions.explanation: 'before that trip' là mốc thời gian/sự kiện ➔ Đã xong trước một thời điểm.

questions.prompt: 5. 'We had eaten lunch by the time the guests arrived.'
options: A. Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ
B. Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ
questions.explanation: Ăn trưa xong trước khi khách đến ('guests arrived') ➔ Xảy ra trước hành động khác.

questions.prompt: 6. 'The movie had ended before we reached the theater.'
options: A. Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ
B. Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ
questions.explanation: Phim kết thúc trước khi chúng tôi đến rạp ➔ Xảy ra trước hành động khác.

questions.prompt: 7. 'She had cleaned the room before her parents came home.'
options: A. Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ
B. Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ
questions.explanation: Dọn phòng trước khi bố mẹ về ➔ Xảy ra trước hành động khác.

questions.prompt: 8. 'I had read the letter before he explained it.'
options: A. Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ
B. Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ
questions.explanation: Đọc thư trước khi anh ấy giải thích ➔ Xảy ra trước hành động khác.

questions.prompt: 9. 'They had completed the project by the deadline.'
options: A. Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ
B. Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ
questions.explanation: 'by the deadline' là mốc thời gian hạn chót ➔ Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ.

questions.prompt: 10. 'He had studied Spanish before moving to Mexico.'
options: A. Đã xong trước một thời điểm trong quá khứ
B. Đã xảy ra trước một hành động khác trong quá khứ
questions.explanation: Học tiếng Tây Ban Nha trước khi chuyển đi Mexico ➔ Xảy ra trước hành động khác.

exercise_groups.group_title: 6. Nhận Diện Dấu Hiệu Quá Khứ Hoàn Thành (10 Câu)
exercise_groups.instruction: Chọn dấu hiệu thời gian / liên từ nhận biết trong câu:

questions.prompt: 'I had finished my homework before the teacher checked it.' ➔ Dấu hiệu là:
options: before the teacher checked it
finished my homework
I had
questions.explanation: 'before + mệnh đề QKĐ' là dấu hiệu của Quá khứ hoàn thành.

questions.prompt: 'She had never seen a rainbow before that day.' ➔ Dấu hiệu là:
options: before that day
seen a rainbow
She had
questions.explanation: 'before that day' là mốc thời gian trước đó.

questions.prompt: 'They had packed their bags by the time the bus arrived.' ➔ Dấu hiệu là:
options: by the time the bus arrived
packed their bags
They had
questions.explanation: 'by the time + mệnh đề QKĐ' là dấu hiệu điển hình.

questions.prompt: 'He had called his friend before the meeting started.' ➔ Dấu hiệu là:
options: before the meeting started
called his friend
the meeting
questions.explanation: 'before the meeting started' là mệnh đề quá khứ đứng sau before.

questions.prompt: 'She had written the essay by the time the deadline passed.' ➔ Dấu hiệu là:
options: by the time the deadline passed
written the essay
the deadline
questions.explanation: 'by the time + mệnh đề QKĐ' diễn tả mốc trước khi thời hạn qua đi.

exercise_groups.group_title: 7. Sắp Xếp Từ Thành Câu Hoàn Chỉnh (10 Câu)
exercise_groups.instruction: Sắp xếp các từ cho sẵn thành câu hoàn chỉnh đúng thì Quá khứ hoàn thành:

questions.prompt: She / write / the report / before / the meeting / start.
answers: She had written the report before the meeting started.
She had written the report before the meeting started
Before the meeting started, she had written the report.
Before the meeting started she had written the report
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: She had written the report before the meeting started.

questions.prompt: They / finish / dinner / by the time / their friends / arrive.
answers: They had finished dinner by the time their friends arrived.
They had finished dinner by the time their friends arrived
By the time their friends arrived, they had finished dinner.
By the time their friends arrived they had finished dinner
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: They had finished dinner by the time their friends arrived.

questions.prompt: He / never / play / that game / before / yesterday.
answers: He had never played that game before yesterday.
He had never played that game before yesterday
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: He had never played that game before yesterday.

questions.prompt: We / clean / the house / before / our guests / come.
answers: We had cleaned the house before our guests came.
We had cleaned the house before our guests came
Before our guests came, we had cleaned the house.
Before our guests came we had cleaned the house
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: We had cleaned the house before our guests came.

questions.prompt: I / read / the book / before / it / become / famous.
answers: I had read the book before it became famous.
I had read the book before it became famous
Before it became famous, I had read the book.
Before it became famous I had read the book
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: I had read the book before it became famous.

questions.prompt: She / pack / her luggage / by the time / the taxi / arrive.
answers: She had packed her luggage by the time the taxi arrived.
She had packed her luggage by the time the taxi arrived
By the time the taxi arrived, she had packed her luggage.
By the time the taxi arrived she had packed her luggage
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: She had packed her luggage by the time the taxi arrived.

questions.prompt: He / study / English / before / he / move / to London.
answers: He had studied English before he moved to London.
He had studied English before he moved to London
Before he moved to London, he had studied English.
Before he moved to London he had studied English
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: He had studied English before he moved to London.

questions.prompt: We / never / hear / that story / before / last night.
answers: We had never heard that story before last night.
We had never heard that story before last night
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: We had never heard that story before last night.

questions.prompt: They / already / leave / before / we / get / to the party.
answers: They had already left before we got to the party.
They had already left before we got to the party
Before we got to the party, they had already left.
Before we got to the party they had already left
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: They had already left before we got to the party.

questions.prompt: I / finish / the assignment / before / the teacher / ask / for it.
answers: I had finished the assignment before the teacher asked for it.
I had finished the assignment before the teacher asked for it
Before the teacher asked for it, I had finished the assignment.
Before the teacher asked for it I had finished the assignment
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc: I had finished the assignment before the teacher asked for it.
